name: Institutional racism
summary: Institutional racism is the analysis that racial disadvantage is produced by the routine policies, practices and norms of institutions, not only by prejudiced individuals. Coined by Stokely Carmichael and Charles Hamilton in 1967 and given an official British definition by the Macpherson Inquiry in 1999, it holds that such racism can be unwitting, is judged by its effects, and requires structural reform, redress and representation rather than only punishing individual bigots.
scope: The mainstream anti-racist analytic framework as set out by Carmichael and Hamilton in Black Power (1967) and the Macpherson Report (1999), plus current policy advocacy (diversity and inclusion measures, redress for historic injustice). Because it is a concept of analysis rather than a full programme, most answers outside race, policing, equality law and political power are low-confidence inferences from a progressive-left orientation. The separatist and Black Power strand is used for community control, not as the whole profile.

keyFigures.name: Stokely Carmichael
keyFigures.role: Co-author of Black Power (1967), which introduced the term institutional racism.

keyFigures.name: Charles V. Hamilton
keyFigures.role: Political scientist and co-author of Black Power, who developed the concept with Carmichael.

keyFigures.name: William Macpherson
keyFigures.role: Chair of the 1999 Stephen Lawrence Inquiry, which found the Metropolitan Police institutionally racist.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Inferred: the health-gap examples in the institutional-racism literature (life expectancy, access to care) imply support for guaranteed public care, though the sources do not discuss funding models.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Inferred from Carmichael and Hamilton's focus on slum exploitation and economic power for black communities; no wage policy is stated.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Inferred: Carmichael and Hamilton prefer "free people" over "free enterprise" and see market-based structures as sustaining racial disadvantage.

public-ownership.rationale: The concept is about racial outcomes, and adherents range from socialists to liberal reformers; no ownership position is stated.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Inferred from the focus on wealth-building gaps and redress; redistribution is a plausible remedy but not stated.

unions-good.rationale: Black Power criticises organised labour for complacency about racism, while other adherents back unions; split.

property-fundamental.rationale: Inferred: housing redlining and exclusionary zoning are treated as racist institutional practices, so absolute property rights are viewed warily.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Inferred from anti-discrimination law and employer practices being named as targets of institutional reform.

cut-welfare.rationale: Inferred: slum deprivation is attributed to institutions rather than individual failing, so cutting welfare is opposed.

worker-ownership.rationale: No stated position; adherents divide between socialist and liberal reform views.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Inferred from the criticism of racial profiling by police and security staff, which surveillance tends to magnify.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Inferred from the criminal-justice critique of racially unequal enforcement and sentencing; drug policy itself is not discussed.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: The Macpherson Inquiry recommended criminalising racist statements made in private as well as public, so adherents back legal limits on racist speech.

strong-leader.rationale: Inferred: the sources stress accountable, community-controlled institutions rather than concentrated executive power.

state-harmful.rationale: Adherents seek an effective share of state power and reform of public institutions, so they reject abolishing the state.

limit-guns.rationale: Black Power advocated fighting back, while mainstream institutional-racism reformers support gun control; split.

empower-police-military.rationale: Police profiling and the Macpherson finding against the Metropolitan Police lead adherents to oppose giving police more power without reform.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: The sources never address it; adherents are split on sex work.

rehabilitation.rationale: Inferred from the critique of racially unequal criminal justice outcomes, which favours reform over punishment.

traditional-family.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive-left orientation of most adherents, hence a weak disagreement.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the broad anti-discrimination framing that lists many grounds of discrimination.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive-left orientation of typical adherents.

more-religion-public.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the secular anti-discrimination framing, though Black churches were central to the civil rights movement.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Redress is a core remedy: the literature calls for acknowledgment, apologies, truth commissions and funded programmes to repair racial disadvantage.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the general view that disadvantage is produced by social institutions.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Black Power rejects assimilation into the dominant white culture and questions the traditions of institutions that exclude minorities.

gradual-change.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton reject gradual, liberal reform that leaves structures intact and call for challenging the institutions themselves.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Inferred from the anti-discrimination stance; immigration levels are not discussed.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Not discussed; the concept is applied to domestic institutions.

nation-first.rationale: Inferred: the Chinese-government example in the sources shows the concept being used against nationalist denial of racism.

open-borders.rationale: Not discussed; adherents range from open-borders to moderate reformers.

limit-growth.rationale: The concept of institutional racism says nothing on growth limits, and adherents split between green-left and growth-oriented reformers.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Inferred from the related environmental-racism concept, which links climate and pollution burdens to race.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Inferred from the view that structural, not technical, change is needed to remove racial disadvantage.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Nuclear power is not addressed in the race-focused literature, and adherents hold no common view.

revolution-justified.rationale: Carmichael endorsed fighting back, but mainstream reformers using the Macpherson framework work through institutions; split.

experts-over-public.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on community control over schools and police rather than deference to officials.

central-planning.rationale: The sources never address economic planning, and adherents include both socialists and market liberals.

socialized-markets.rationale: The sources never address worker or public ownership within markets; adherents are indifferent as a group.

land-value-tax.rationale: A land tax is never discussed in the sources and the concept does not bear on it.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from the focus on intergenerational wealth gaps as a product of discrimination.

basic-income.rationale: Inferred as a possible remedy for structural economic disadvantage; not stated.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Trade protection is not addressed by Carmichael, Hamilton or Macpherson, and adherents disagree.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Inferred from calls to reshape economic structures for black communities, though no investment policy is stated.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Inferred from Black Power's push for black ownership and economic bases in the community.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Not discussed; Black Power seeks a share in existing economic power rather than abolishing money.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from preference for public institutions reformed rather than dismantled.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised bargaining bodies are not discussed, and adherents have no shared view.

one-party-rule.rationale: Adherents call for pluralist politics in which black communities hold a bargaining share of power, not single-party rule.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Inferred from the opposition to inherited, unearned advantage.

democracy-best.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton seek to widen participation and power-sharing within the political system, though they criticise its present exclusions.

direct-votes.rationale: Direct democracy on laws is not addressed; adherents worry both about majority bias and about unresponsive legislatures.

workers-councils.rationale: Council-based power is not addressed in the sources, and the concept is not tied to any one constitutional form.

right-to-secede.rationale: Not discussed; Black Power's sovereignty language is mostly about community control, not secession.

natural-rulers.rationale: Adherents hold that racial hierarchies are socially produced, so natural fitness to rule is rejected.

political-violence-never.rationale: Carmichael rejected nonviolence as a strategy while later institutional reformers reject political violence; split.

war-builds-character.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

separate-church-state.rationale: Not discussed; Black churches are both political and religious institutions.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the secular anti-discrimination framework.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Inferred from the focus on reforming public justice and policing institutions for accountability.

military-superiority.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The concept is aimed at practices that privilege one ethnic group, so adherents reject a nation defined by one ethnicity.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton stress race over class, though other adherents are Marxist; split.

equal-outcomes.rationale: The literature proposes substantive equality, including equality of outcomes, as a way to prevent institutional racism.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Inferred from the redress for Indigenous peoples in Canada and Australia discussed in the literature.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Inferred from the redress and apology approach to colonial-era racism; reparations are not stated.

civilizational-union.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the anti-hierarchy outlook.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Inferred from Carmichael and Hamilton's emphasis on human dignity and communal solidarity over property and profit.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Not discussed; the framework is rights-based.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: The intrinsic value of nature is outside the scope of the concept, and adherents hold no shared view.

limit-population.rationale: Inferred from the history of racialised population control, though not discussed in the sources.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: The sources do not take a view on industrial civilisation as a whole, and adherents split between critics and reformers.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Speeding technological change is not discussed; adherents are divided between hopes and worries about biased systems.

human-enhancement.rationale: Bodily enhancement is not addressed by the concept and adherents have no shared view.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Inferred from concern that systems reproduce disadvantage without accountability; not in the sources.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Encryption is not discussed in the sources; adherents weigh privacy from policing against other concerns.

restore-past-order.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton treat the past order as the source of institutional racism, so restoring it is rejected.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Outcome-based tests of racism favour results, but adherents hold a firm anti-racist ideology; split.

direct-action.rationale: Black Power favoured organising and direct challenge alongside electoral politics; split.

means-match-ends.rationale: Prefigurative method is not discussed; Black Power ranged from nonviolent to confrontational tactics.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: The sources do not address the division of labour, and the concept does not bear on it.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Distribution by need is not discussed; adherents range from socialists to liberal reformers.

production-for-use.rationale: Production for use rather than profit is not addressed in the race-focused sources and adherents are split.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Black Power critiques economic exploitation of black communities, but adherents vary on the Marxist labour theory.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the pluralist power-sharing goal.

collective-farming.rationale: Farm organisation is not discussed in the sources and the concept does not bear on it.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Theories of imperialist war are not discussed, and adherents split between Marxist and liberal readings.

taxation-theft.rationale: Remedies in the literature rely on public funding and state programmes, so adherents reject treating taxation as theft.

harm-principle.rationale: Not discussed; the concept supports legal restraint of discrimination beyond individual harm.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton argue for group power and group solidarity, and the concept holds that racial groups face collective disadvantage.

conscription.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Adherents prioritise voice and political power inside the system; exit does not address institutional racism.

state-as-business.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on equal public service as a collective duty; Macpherson defines the failure as one of service.

positive-liberty.rationale: Inferred from the stress on material and political power as preconditions of freedom for black people.

media-academia-power.rationale: The sources do not weigh media and universities against elected officials, and adherents have no common view.

hereditarian-race.rationale: The concept rests on racial disadvantage as socially produced, and it was developed in opposition to biological racial ranking.

organic-representation.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the aim of equal participation in standard political institutions.

total-state.rationale: Inferred from the push for community control and pluralism.

national-rebirth.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the anti-colonial strand.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the opposition to unaccountable, patronage-based power.

bound-labor.rationale: Bound labour recalls slavery and its legacy, which the literature treats as foundational racial injustice.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Inferred from the claim that standardised tests and other apparently neutral practices can embed bias; not stated generally.

universal-morality.rationale: Metaethics is not addressed; adherents range from universalists to relativists.

single-common-good.rationale: Black Power starts from distinct group interests that need bargaining power in a pluralistic system.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Diaspora return rights are outside the concept's scope, and adherents hold varied views.

revive-national-language.rationale: Language revival is not addressed by the sources, and adherents have no shared view.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Inferred from the push for participation and power in institutions.

school-vouchers.rationale: Black Power wants community control of schools, but vouchers are not discussed.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Inferred from the preference for spending on remedial programmes.

economic-freedom.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton prefer "free people" to "free enterprise", but the claim here is about political freedom's durability; unaddressed.

rule-by-example.rationale: Macpherson-style reform relies on rules and accountability, not rulers' example.

national-self-determination.rationale: Black Power seeks self-definition and a degree of community sovereignty, so the principle is inferred as supported.

force-without-un.rationale: Authorisation of foreign force is not discussed; adherents are divided.

reason-over-faith.rationale: The sources do not address faith versus reason, and Black churches have been central to the movement while others are secular.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Inferred from the anti-discrimination stance, which opposes status-based exclusion from services.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Inferred from the view that deprivation is institutional rather than a failing of individuals.

class-collaboration.rationale: Employer and worker cooperation is not discussed by Carmichael, Hamilton or Macpherson, and adherents hold both views.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Sacrificing cultural institutions is not discussed; adherents would weigh access and representation against preservation.

dominated-front.rationale: Carmichael linked black people to a Third World force, but a front of states is not discussed.

workers-nation.rationale: National versus international working-class organisation is not addressed in the sources.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the broad anti-discrimination framing.

ban-interest.rationale: Interest bans are not discussed in the sources, and adherents have no shared view.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Segregation is a paradigm case of institutional discrimination, and the literature names residential segregation as a harm to remedy.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Adherents see the state as racially biased, but class-instrument theory is not specifically held.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Inferred from environmental-racism concerns over pollution burdens.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton reject assimilation into white middle-class America as a goal.

elite-replacement.rationale: The theory is a conspiracy claim of the kind the framework opposes as racist stereotyping.

proportional-representation.rationale: Inferred from the stress on political representation of racial minorities as a dimension of institutional racism.

national-mission.rationale: A national mission to spread a form of government is not addressed; adherents are mixed on foreign policy.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: The article on institutional discrimination covers gender alongside race as a ground, supporting a structural reading, though the sources focus on race.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Not discussed as such; elites are criticised for racial bias, not corruption.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Eugenic prevention is a historical form of institutional racism and disability discrimination; adherents oppose it.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: The Macpherson Inquiry's recommendations centred on police accountability and reform after the failed investigation of a racist killing.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The remedies require an active state through anti-discrimination law and funded programmes.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Laws and norms against interracial relations are classic institutional racism, and Carmichael and Hamilton note that whites narrowly framed integration as intermarriage.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The concept's premise is that unequal treatment by race violates equal worth; Macpherson defines racism by unequal professional service.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Debates on socialism in one country are not part of the concept, and adherents hold no shared view.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Inferred from the colonial-institution examples (Algeria, Indigenous Australia, Canada) in the literature.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: A common civil code is not addressed in the sources; adherents divide between equal-treatment and minority-autonomy arguments.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from opposition to discrimination on religion.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Cattle slaughter bans are not discussed, and the concept does not bear on them.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Religious instruction in state schools is not addressed by the sources and adherents are divided.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: The Marxist state-and-encirclement debate is not addressed by the concept.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Inferred from the demand for black people to hold an effective share in power.

trade-surplus.rationale: Export surplus targets are not addressed in the sources and adherents have no shared view.

population-transfer.rationale: Forced removal of a minority is a form of institutional discrimination the framework condemns.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: The non-aggression principle is not addressed; Black Power rejected pure nonviolence while reformers rely on state force against discrimination.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Rejects racial struggle as progress; the framework sees competition on unequal terms as reproducing disadvantage.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Macpherson-style reformers back limits on racist speech, but party bans are not discussed.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Inferred from the focus on black people's power to avoid dependence on white-controlled institutions.

separated-powers.rationale: Inferred from the interest in checks, bargaining power and challenges to institutions.

vanguard-party.rationale: Black Power stresses community organising and self-leadership, not a revolutionary party.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Slum deprivation is cited as a central example of institutional racism, so laws prioritising the poor are inferred as supported.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Council-home sales are not discussed, and adherents weigh asset-building against public housing stock.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton attribute black poverty to institutions, not to population or individual failings.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Diversity and inclusion initiatives are core remedies in the literature, which rejects the claim that diversity harms cohesion.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Lotteries for office are not discussed in the sources and adherents have no shared view.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Inferred from the stress on equal legal protection and criticism of profiling.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price controls on food are not addressed, and adherents have no shared view.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Pay caps for representatives are not addressed in the sources.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party discipline is not addressed in the sources, and adherents work in many different parties.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Supranational union is not addressed in the sources and adherents are divided.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Executive command of the military is not addressed by the concept.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is outside the concept's scope.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Revolutionary defeatism is not discussed, and adherents hold no shared view on great-power wars.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Macpherson-style reformers back legal limits on racist speech, but censoring art on virtue grounds goes beyond that.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Term limits are not addressed by the sources and adherents have no shared view.

recall-officials.rationale: Inferred from the stress on accountability of officials to the communities they serve.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Military alliances are not addressed by the sources, and adherents hold varied positions.

people-in-arms.rationale: Not discussed; Black Power endorsed fighting back but not an armed-citizenry army.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Not discussed; housing discrimination is the concern, not tenure.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: The moral value of rural versus urban life is not addressed in the sources.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Reunification of divided nations is not addressed in the sources.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Inferred from the rejection of ranking peoples; the sources do not state a cultural view.

death-penalty.rationale: Inferred from the criticism of racially unequal criminal justice.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Creationism in schools is not discussed, though many adherents also oppose it, so the position is a weak guess.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Pornography regulation is not addressed by the sources, and adherents are split.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Inferred: descent-based rules disadvantage minorities, so adherents prefer birthright.

minority-language-support.rationale: Inferred from the concern that institutions fail people because of culture and ethnic origin, as in Macpherson's definition.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Religious exemptions from general law are not addressed, and adherents weigh minority protection against equal application.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: The sources do not discuss social conformity and personal liberty, and adherents hold no common view.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Debt cancellation is not discussed in the sources, and adherents divide.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Inferred: Black Power links formal rights to economic and political power.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Constitutional procedure is not addressed in the sources.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Inferred from the stress on political voice for excluded groups.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Nuclear deterrence is not discussed, and adherents hold varied views.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Method of electing the head of state is not discussed in the sources.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Central-bank independence is not addressed by the sources and adherents have no shared view.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Territorial concessions for peace are not addressed, and adherents split.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton favour human dignity over property; weakly inferred.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: The characterisation of the Soviet Union is not addressed in the sources.

collective-defense.rationale: Collective defence pacts are not discussed in the sources and adherents are divided.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Annexation and occupation law is not discussed in the sources.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: State control over clergy is not discussed, and adherents are divided over the role of churches.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: A nonpartisan head of state is not addressed by the sources.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Military force against secession is not discussed, and adherents hold varied views.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Regional autonomy within a larger state is not discussed in the sources.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Inferred from the opposition to inherited, unearned status.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Inferred from preference for progressive tax in service of redistribution.

character-from-environment.rationale: The concept holds that disadvantage comes from institutions and circumstances, not innate traits, as in the Birmingham poverty example.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The Macpherson approach demands institutions be answerable to the law and public, including the police.

space-expansion.rationale: Space expansion is not discussed in the sources and the concept does not bear on it.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Mixed constitutions are not discussed in the sources and adherents hold no shared view.

leader-cult.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on collective community power.

equal-parenting.rationale: Default shared parenting is not discussed by the sources, and adherents split on it.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Class struggle under socialism is not discussed by the concept, and adherents hold no shared view.

land-redistribution.rationale: Inferred from redress for dispossessed Indigenous peoples.

refugee-return.rationale: Inferred from redress and acknowledgment for expelled groups.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Inferred from the opposition to ethnic nationalism.

women-must-cover.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the anti-discrimination framework.

common-currency.rationale: Currency unions are not addressed in the sources.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Carmichael backed pan-African and Third World solidarity, but language-family unions are not discussed.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton favour parallel community institutions and black control of schools, a form of cultural self-government.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Black Power seeks an effective share of power within American society, not emigration.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Historical materialism is not part of the concept; Carmichael and Hamilton stress race and power, while some adherents are Marxist.

ban-cartels.rationale: Inferred from the concern about concentrations of unaccountable power.

no-bailouts.rationale: Bailouts are not discussed in the sources, and adherents divide.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Anti-discrimination law is a countermeasure, which means courts must be able to constrain majorities to protect minorities.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Diversity and representation measures are a stated remedy for race; inferred to extend to gender.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Imperial self-sufficient blocs are not discussed in the sources.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Inferred from the concern over unequal burdens.

moral-incentives.rationale: Moral versus material incentives are not discussed by the sources.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Not discussed; Black Power stressed community organisation.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: The framework opposes unearned systemic advantage, a view extended to inherited privilege.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: The colonial-institution examples in the literature treat such rule as racist.

patriotic-education.rationale: Black Power wants education that redefines black history and identity rather than uncritical national pride.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Inferred from the demand for self-definition and revised historical perspectives on race.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Affirmative action and DEI are named remedies, so adherents oppose abolishing racial preferences.

public-money-creation.rationale: Money creation is not discussed in the sources and adherents hold no shared view.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Capitalism's adaptability is not discussed, and adherents range from reformists to revolutionaries.

delink-world-market.rationale: Delinking is not discussed by the race-focused sources, and adherents divide.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: The labour aristocracy thesis is not part of the concept and adherents hold no shared view.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Anti-discrimination law is listed as a countermeasure, so adherents reject a right to discriminate in public commerce and employment.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Inferred from legal protection against discrimination.

elective-rulers.rationale: Inferred from the call for political participation.

minority-veto.rationale: Minority vetoes are not discussed in the sources, though adherents favour protection for minorities in majoritarian systems, so views vary.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Inferred from Black Power's call to challenge lawless institutional racism and fight back.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Parliamentary supremacy is not discussed in the sources, and adherents weigh it against judicial protection of minorities.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Animal welfare is outside the concept's scope.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Animal use is outside the concept's scope.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton criticise white liberal paternalism and favour power over charity.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: The framework calls for political engagement and power building, not withdrawal.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton say white liberals acted as a buffer muting black anger, but mass culture is not discussed.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Hegemony theory is not part of the concept, though Carmichael and Hamilton say respectable people sustain institutional racism, so adherents are split.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: World-systems theory is not part of the concept, though Black Power linked black Americans to a Third World force; adherents are split.

native-born-offices.rationale: Inferred from the anti-discrimination stance on political representation.

party-own-road.rationale: Inter-party relations among communists are not discussed.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Development strategy is not discussed in the sources, and adherents hold varied views.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Irredentism is not discussed in the sources and adherents hold no shared view.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Not discussed; adherents are split on whether it is a remedy.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Inferred from the opposition to racist ideology.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Equating fascism and communism is not addressed in the sources and adherents differ.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Slavery is a foundational racial institution in the literature, so denial is rejected.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Inferred from the acknowledgment and redress approach to past racial injustice.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Policy attention to male disadvantage is not discussed, and adherents are divided.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Gendered violence policy is not addressed in the race-focused sources, and adherents are divided.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: The Chinese-government example shows adherents reject cultural claims used to deny systemic racism.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Inferred from the concern about unaccountable armed power.

filial-duty.rationale: Filial obligation is not discussed in the sources and the concept does not bear on it.

office-by-exam.rationale: Standardised tests are named as a mechanism of institutional racism in education.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Blocking foreign takeovers is not discussed in the sources.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the progressive orientation.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Inferred from the stress on accountability to the community.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from preference for public provision.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Use-based land tenure is not discussed in the sources.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Parliamentary budget control is not discussed in the sources, though adherents generally accept it.

single-official-language.rationale: Inferred from Macpherson's concern about failure of service on grounds of culture and origin.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: The Macpherson definition judges institutions by effect, including unwitting prejudice, and Carmichael and Hamilton define institutional racism by outcomes rather than intent.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Consumerism is not discussed in the sources and adherents have no shared view.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Funding insurgents is not discussed in the sources, and adherents are divided.

corporate-influence.rationale: Inferred from the concern about concentrated power.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Foreign funding rules for NGOs are not discussed in the sources, and adherents are divided.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Birth incentives are not discussed in the sources, and adherents are divided.

residents-only-property.rationale: Exclusionary zoning is named as an institutional racism mechanism, so local restrictions on purchases are viewed warily.

job-guarantee.rationale: Inferred from the focus on economic deprivation.

democratic-peace.rationale: The democratic peace thesis is outside the sources, and adherents hold no shared view.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Obedience to law is not discussed directly, and adherents split between civil disobedience and respect for equality law.

non-intervention.rationale: Non-intervention is not addressed in the sources and adherents are divided.

industrial-unions.rationale: Union structure is not discussed in the sources.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Conspiracy claims about a minority are racist stereotyping that Macpherson names as a cause of institutional racism.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Legal marriage is not discussed in the sources, and adherents are divided.

public-access-to-information.rationale: The Macpherson recommendations included openness and accountability for police and public bodies.

local-production.rationale: Local production is not discussed in the sources and the concept does not bear on it.

informal-organisation.rationale: Organisational form is not discussed in the sources; Black Power groups used both formal and informal structures.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Primacy of national law is not discussed in the sources and adherents are divided.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Tributary deference between states is not discussed in the sources.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Regional revenue sharing is not discussed in the sources, and adherents hold no shared view.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Personal property under common ownership of production is not discussed in the sources.

defeat-communism.rationale: Cold War anti-communism is not discussed in the concept, and adherents hold varied positions.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Macpherson speaks of an organisation's service to all; provider mix is not discussed.

religion-illusion.rationale: The sources do not discuss religion as illusion, and Black churches have been central to the movement while others are secular.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: The sources do not weigh capitalism's historical role, and adherents range from reformists to anti-capitalists.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Inferred from the structural account applied to gender.

socialized-care.rationale: Public provision of care work is not discussed in the sources, and adherents are divided.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the anti-exclusion orientation.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Small cooperative communes are not discussed in the sources.

treaties-binding.rationale: Inferred from the redress for Indigenous peoples.

majority-settlement.rationale: Policies steering a majority into minority areas would be seen as institutional discrimination.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Third-way economics is not discussed in the sources.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Competing historical land claims are not discussed in the sources, though adherents support Indigenous claims in some cases, so views vary.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Denial is a form of racist stereotyping and falsification; the framework opposes it.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Inferred from the broad anti-discrimination framework.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Adherents seek political voice and participation, not suppression.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Blasphemy law is not discussed in the sources, and adherents are divided.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Religious war duties are not discussed in the sources.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Religious legitimacy of rulers is not discussed in the sources.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton call for ordinary black people to lead and run their own organisations and control local schools.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: The institutional-discrimination literature lists race with gender, class and other grounds; the sources do not state an intersectional thesis.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the broad anti-discrimination framework.

assisted-dying.rationale: Assisted dying is not discussed in the sources and adherents hold no shared view.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: The sources do not say whether left and right are obsolete, and adherents mostly work within that divide.

alienated-labor.rationale: Alienated labour is not discussed in the race-focused sources, and adherents split between Marxists and liberals.

islam-incompatible.rationale: The claim is a stereotype of the type the framework opposes in institutions.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Divine sources of authority are not discussed in the sources, and adherents differ by religion.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Inferred from opposition to exclusion based on culture and origin.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Inferred from the accountability and anti-discrimination framework.

social-market-economy.rationale: Inferred from reformist remedies within existing economies.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Abolishing armed forces is not discussed in the sources, and adherents hold varied views.

rich-first.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton reject trickle-down arrangements and demand an immediate effective share for the excluded.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Bloc neutrality is not discussed in the sources, and adherents hold varied views.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Inferred from opposition to inherited advantage.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutual credit banking is not discussed in the sources.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Inferred from the concern about austerity's burden on disadvantaged groups.

property-franchise.rationale: Limiting the vote to property owners is exclusion from political power; Carmichael and Hamilton argue for black enfranchisement and an effective share in power.

decide-locally.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton demand black community control of local schools and parallel community institutions.

party-controls-media.rationale: Adherents seek independent black voices and open political competition, and oppose state or party control of information.

party-commands-army.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from the concern with accountable, civilian-controlled security institutions.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Foreign land ownership is not discussed in the sources, and adherents hold varied views.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from opposition to domination of weaker peoples.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: The literature treats colonial institutions such as in Algeria and Tibet as sites of institutional racism.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Inferred: the structural, intersecting-oppression analysis of racism extends naturally to linked hierarchies, though the sources do not discuss ecology.

reification.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation: the sources treat disadvantage as produced by institutions people built, not by neutral forces, but do not discuss commodity relations.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Inferred: Black Power writing stresses that the powerless lack control of institutions that shape public opinion, though it does not address press ownership directly.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Inferred: the analysis demands that rules apply equally and be open to scrutiny, though its sources do not discuss decree versus standing law.

racial-franchise.rationale: Black Power and the Macpherson analysis demand equal political participation and representation for all races; a racially limited franchise is the opposite of their aims.

online-participation.rationale: Inferred: advocates favour wider and more representative participation, but the sources predate or ignore online politics.

open-government-data.rationale: Inferred: monitoring outcomes by ethnicity is central to detecting institutional discrimination, which implies published records, though the sources do not discuss open data.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Inferred: the framework opposes legally enforced group boundaries and discrimination, though religion and marriage are not addressed.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Inferred: targeting a minority's businesses is the kind of discrimination the framework condemns, though Black Power also urged community-owned business for its own community.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Inferred: calls for community control and greater representation suggest support for participatory bodies, though assemblies chosen by lot are not discussed.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: The ideology is a concept of analysis with no doctrine on religion; adherents are neither for nor against, so this is left neutral.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Inferred from Carmichael and Hamilton's argument that economic power, not just the vote, decides black communities' freedom; the sources do not discuss wealth concentration as such.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation of the framework and its opposition to institutional discrimination; military service is not discussed.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Inferred: the framework is secular-neutral on religion and concerned with racial structures; state promotion of unbelief is not part of it.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Adherents split between reforming police, as in the Macpherson recommendations, and abolishing them; the concept itself does not decide the matter.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Inferred from the emphasis on representation and group political power for black communities; power-sharing is not directly stated.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Inferred: Carmichael and Hamilton favour black community power and structural change over paternalistic aid, and public programmes over private charity.

term-limits.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; term limits have no clear bearing on the analysis of institutional racism.

vote-delegation.rationale: Not addressed by the sources and adherents have no settled position on delegable voting.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; the framework concerns present racial disadvantage and takes no stance on extinction risk.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation and opposition to exclusion; religious office is not discussed.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation of the framework; marriage is not discussed in the sources.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Inferred: the concept targets exclusion of minorities from political power and representation, which points toward giving long-term residents a say locally.

rent-control.rationale: Inferred: housing discrimination is a standard example in the literature, which suggests support for legal limits on rents in tight markets.

abolish-ip.rationale: Not addressed; a progressive-left orientation generally keeps intellectual property rights, so mild disagreement is inferred.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a civil-libertarian, community-control stance that opposes state-run drilled youth organisations.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the progressive-left orientation the scope describes, which generally opposes nuclear basing.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Inferred from the Black Power strand's anti-imperialist and pan-Africanist politics in Carmichael's later writings.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Inferred from the scope's emphasis on redress for historic injustice, which implies official acknowledgement of past mass atrocities.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Inferred: Carmichael later described his politics as socialist, and the concept criticises economic disadvantage built into institutions.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Black Power argues for the right of Black communities to defend themselves and explicitly rejects pacifism as a principle.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Not addressed; the framework treats identities and institutions as historically made, so continuity claims are inferred to be rejected.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation, which commonly holds that sex categories are shaped by culture.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Inferred from the intersectional analysis common in current advocacy, which treats group experience as varying by race and class.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a secular rights framework that favours restrained, non-sacral commemoration.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Not addressed; the analysis explains disadvantage through institutions and power, not spiritual conflict.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Not addressed; the concept is about institutions within states and does not take a position on homelands and diasporas.

culture-before-state.rationale: Not addressed; Black Power stresses both cultural pride and political power, with no stated order between them.

god-not-male.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation, which commonly favours inclusive religious language.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Inferred from the equality-law and representation emphasis, which judges institutions by whether they treat people equally.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: The concept condemns structures that reserve economic opportunity for one group, and the Macpherson and equality-law tradition demands open access regardless of group.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Not addressed; the analysis concerns discrimination in existing institutions, not the drawing of regional borders.

independent-unions.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation of the framework; unions are not discussed in the sources.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Inferred: Carmichael later moved to socialism and the framework stresses power for the disadvantaged; the concept itself does not address what counts as socialism.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Inferred from Carmichael and Hamilton's attack on exploitation of black communities by outside owners and services; public provision is not stated.

second-chamber.rationale: The concept says nothing about legislative structure, and adherents have no common view.

municipal-property.rationale: Black Power calls for community economic control, but via black-owned and cooperative enterprise, not a stated municipal-ownership doctrine.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Not addressed; community control is stressed, but nothing is said about confederal structures.

family-wage.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; adherents are split between household-wage and individual-equity arguments.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Inferred from the literature on medical racism and unequal treatment, which favours caution over speed in testing.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Not addressed; no common adherent position is evident.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; adherents are split between privacy and anti-discrimination concerns.

online-anonymity.rationale: Not addressed; adherents weigh anonymity against online harassment and have no common view.

person-over-state.rationale: Inferred: the framework protects individuals from being treated as members of a subordinate group, though it is not argued in these terms.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; the concept is about institutional practice, not human nature.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Inferred from the civil-rights record, where national authority overrode state and local discrimination; the sources do not state this.

gm-crops.rationale: Not addressed; no inference is possible beyond the general progressive orientation.

dense-cities.rationale: Not addressed; urban segregation is discussed, but not density as an environmental matter.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton argue that black people must organise as a group to gain political power and form coalitions on their own terms.

racial-pride.rationale: Black pride and self-definition are central to Black Power as Carmichael presented it.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Inferred from Carmichael's anti-imperialist and anti-Vietnam War stance; the institutional-racism concept itself is silent.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Inferred: the framework analyses racial disadvantage within institutions, not language-based nationhood; Black Power's solidarity is racial and diasporic, not linguistic.

communal-electorates.rationale: Inferred: the concept calls for equal treatment and representation in common institutions; separate religious electorates are not discussed.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Inferred: the framework attributes disadvantage to domestic institutional practices, not foreign plots.

free-public-college.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation and emphasis on removing barriers to access in education; tuition is not discussed in the sources.

pollution-taxes.rationale: The concept is an analytic one with no stated position on pollution pricing versus regulation; environmental justice advocates favour both.

future-generations.rationale: Inferred from a progressive-left orientation that stresses redress for harms handed down; sources do not discuss the environment.

women-distinct-values.rationale: The framework is indifferent here; it analyses racial disparities rather than women's values, and advocates disagree on whether women's outlook should get extra weight.

arms-reduction.rationale: Inferred from the progressive-left orientation and Carmichael's opposition to the Vietnam war; arms levels are not discussed directly.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from a progressive-left orientation favouring accountability and transparency; diplomacy is not discussed.

capital-controls.rationale: The concept says nothing on capital flows and advocates are split along general left lines.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: The concept says nothing on armed groups; adherents are split between distrust of police and support for disarming militias.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Not addressed by the concept; Black Power-era figures opposed Vietnam, but the framework does not require refusal. Adherents split.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Inferred: unions and collective bargaining are seen as routes to fairer pay, though the concept also criticises discriminatory union practices.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Inferred from support for redress of racial economic disparity through public policy.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Inferred: binding borrowing limits would constrain the public spending that structural reform and redress require.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Carmichael tied racism to colonialism and global exploitation, but the concept is mainly about domestic institutions; inferred.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The framework calls for reforming institutions, rebuilding their policies and practices, rather than abolishing the state; Black Power radicals differed.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Not addressed by the concept; adherents hold a range of economic views.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Not addressed; environmental justice strands may object to pricing nature, but there is no settled position.

sacred-nation.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton and Macpherson-style analysis treat national institutions as sites of racial disadvantage; adherents would reject a sacred nation, as it has been used to exclude minorities.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Inferred from concern with racial wealth gaps, to which student debt contributes.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton's Black Power explicitly framed Black communities as internal colonies exploited from outside, the founding use of the analogy.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Anti-racism rests on the equal dignity of all people, but the concept itself does not address human nature; inferred.

public-service-media.rationale: Inferred from support for representation and accountability in major institutions; the concept does not address media funding.

missingStatements.text: Police forces should be held to account for racial disparities in stops, arrests and outcomes, even where no officer intends to discriminate.
missingStatements.rationale: The Macpherson finding of institutional racism rested on collective failure and unwitting prejudice, not individual intent.

missingStatements.text: Institutions can be racist in effect even when no individual in them holds racist views.
missingStatements.rationale: This is the defining claim of the concept in Carmichael and Hamilton and in the Macpherson definition.

missingStatements.text: Black communities should control their own schools and local institutions.
missingStatements.rationale: Carmichael and Hamilton call for black parents to control schools and for parallel community institutions.
missingStatements.declined: Specific Black Power programme of community-controlled schools; narrow to one movement and not worth a question every audit must answer.

notes: Contested between the Black Power strand, which stresses autonomy and distrusts coalitions with white liberals, and the Macpherson and DEI strand, which works through reform of mainstream institutions. Critics dispute that unwitting disparities amount to racism. Some distinguish institutional racism within one organisation from structural racism across institutions.
